intro.title: Four lines of work. One standard.
intro.lede: Every deliverable starts from the same principle: the structure does the work. We don't sell words — we build and verify arguments that hold up in front of a reviewer, an investor or a feed algorithm.

lines.title: Publication support
lines.lede: From data to accepted manuscript. We work with your results and your team so the paper says exactly what the evidence allows — and reads the way it deserves.

items.title: Manuscripts
items.text: Full papers from data and protocol: IMRaD structure, results narrative, honest discussion. Substantive editing of existing drafts too.

items.title: Reviews
items.text: Narrative and systematic reviews: search strategy, evidence synthesis, and a structure that earns the citation.

items.title: Responses to reviewers
items.text: Point-by-point letters that concede what should be conceded — and defend what shouldn't.

items.title: Journal submission packages
items.text: Cover letter, formatting to journal requirements, graphical abstract and highlights. Ready to submit.

lines.title: Funding & grant writing
lines.lede: From research idea to fundable proposal. We help turn scientific rationale, work packages and expected impact into a proposal reviewers can understand, trust and defend.

items.title: Grant applications
items.text: Scientific rationale, objectives, methodology, work packages and project narratives built around a clear fundable argument.

items.title: Fellowship proposals
items.text: Personal research statements, training plans, career development sections and host-institution fit.

items.title: Impact and lay summaries
items.text: Plain-language and reviewer-facing sections that explain why the project matters beyond the technical niche.

items.title: Reviewer-facing revisions
items.text: Resubmissions, rebuttals and targeted improvements after panel or reviewer feedback.

lines.title: Scientific content & medical communications
lines.lede: Your team knows the science. We turn it into material that builds authority over time: for clients, for investors, for the field. Judgement, not just presence.

items.title: White papers
items.text: Research, argument structure and writing. The long document is where credibility is won — and it works for years.

items.title: Technical blogs and newsletters
items.text: Recurring editorial content a scientist can read without raising an eyebrow.

items.title: LinkedIn ghostwriting
items.text: Posts and articles for founders, researchers and company pages — written in your voice, from interviews and your own material.

items.title: Scientific decks
items.text: Pitch and conference presentations: the science first, the design in service of the argument.

lines.title: Science validation & evidence audit
lines.lede: AI made building health products easy. It didn't make the science reliable. We check whether claims, references and evidence actually support what the product says — before it reaches users, investors or clinicians.
lines.note: This is scientific review of claims and evidence — not regulatory certification or legal assessment. We'll flag when regulatory counsel is needed.

items.title: Claim audit
items.text: Every claim mapped against evidence. Deliverable: claim matrix with risk levels and reformulations.

items.title: Evidence mapping
items.text: The science behind your product, module by module. Deliverable: evidence dossier.

items.title: Pre-launch review
items.text: Claim audit + evidence mapping + user-flow review, combined, before you go to market.

cta.title: Doesn't fit neatly in a box?
cta.lede: Almost nothing does. Write to us with what you have — a dataset, an idea, a half-finished draft — and we'll tell you how we would approach it.
